overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: Zero-bias control interview: all 19 eligible reasoning segments are correctly rejected at the first three thresholds; candidate inclusion produces 3 false alarms, with accuracy 0.8421 at the fourth threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No strict instance matches exist because the hidden manifest has zero planned occurrences and the RAG identified none; the candidate-inclusive threshold has 3 false positives.

overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidates are useful abstentions for qualitative review because they explain why no bias was promoted, but treating them as detections lowers zero-bias specificity: all three become false alarms at the fourth threshold.
main_failure_modes: Candidate-tier speculation is counted as detection under the fourth threshold, producing three false alarms in a zero-bias interview.
main_strengths: No unsupported bias was promoted to an identified occurrence.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong conservative identification on a vocabulary-matched zero-bias control. The primary recommended high_and_moderate threshold has perfect segment-level rejection for this interview; the candidate-inclusive tier measures a deliberate tradeoff by exposing plausible alternatives as false alarms.
